title: Restriction commutes with circuit evaluation
statement: Let $n,m�\in\mathbb{N}$, let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and assign a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube to each input of $T$. For a set $J$ of coordinates and a fixed sign assignment $z$ on its complement, reindex the free coordinates of each restricted function by the $|J|$ positions of $J$. Then restricting the function computed by $T$ gives exactly the function computed by $T$ from the individually restricted input functions, using the same gate $g$.
